column1: # What the differential test compares, and where each file came from.
# Columns: role, source (commit:path, or the path in this repo), sha256 of the text with CR removed.
# v0.1.0 (commit 68b0863, tag object 10a21c8) is the only published build. No rolling dev
# pre-release was published, and no predecessor repo shipped this mod. No release ZIP or launcher
# manifest shipped or seeded a HeadTracking.ini: every player's file is the one
# config_write_default_if_missing wrote on the first run, edited or not.
# The reader was frozen at bf04d3e, whose src/ is v0.1.0's byte for byte; only the core pin moved
# (665a345 to 3f3a821). Every core source either reader compiles holds the same bytes at both pins
# except cameraunlock/effects/head_follow_light.h, where one comment changed, so comparison 1
